title: On the Falling Away of the Synagogue
english: On the falling away of the synagogue, or the renaming of Abram as Abraham.

Of Saint Cyril, from the discourse entitled Demonstration, through the divine oracles spoken from the first to the inspired patriarchs, concerning the exchange and transfer involving the Jews and the nations.
The renaming of Abraham has been found to signify the threefold count of the divine and sovereign persons: for though the inspired patriarch was called Abram, God renamed him Abraham (Genesis 17:5).

If anyone should choose to interpret the matter — taking the opening letter of the name, alpha, together with the letter joined and clinging to it, I mean beta — he will surely discover, by carrying over the alpha that stands after rho,
